cr.title: Port the Nebius Builders surface into dev.nebius.com — content, then features
cr.reference_build: demo.buildspace.tv (the Builders mockup that demonstrates the target end-state)

target.stack: Next.js Pages Router + Gravity UI + Page Constructor + Directus CMS (+ HubSpot forms)
target.note: dev.nebius.com already runs this exact stack, so both content and components port closely. It uses Directus today only as a headless asset store (no program data model).

content.name: Content library
content.count_basis: live on the reference build (incl. 55 dev.nebius.com resources from the Phase-1 import + a 4-wave verified discovery sweep)
content.notes: The content backbone. `surface` controls which product page each entry rails onto (/ai-cloud, /token-factory, /serverless, /tavily); `pinned` floats an entry to a page's quickstarts and the homepage WorkshopSpotlight. Every external URL is link-checked (oEmbed for YouTube).

content.name: Community apps / 'built with Nebius' gallery
content.count_basis: live on the reference build (community OSS + hackathon projects, fork-audited for live public repos)
content.notes: Social proof of what builders ship. Placeholder/test rows excluded; repo_urls audited so no dead 'View on GitHub' links. Forks credit the original creator.

content.name: Ecosystem integrations
content.count_basis: apps/web/src/lib/ecosystem-partners.ts (partner integrations: LiteLLM, LlamaIndex, LangChain, CrewAI, Tavily, Mastra, Zed, Cline, Continue, etc.)
content.notes: Currently a typed TS list for SSG. Recommend migrating to a Directus collection so DevRel can edit without a deploy. `products` uses the hyphenated enum (token-factory, ai-cloud, tavily).

content.name: Events directory
content.count: TBC at migration (sourced from lu.ma/NebiusAI + nebius.com/events)
content.notes: Geo-coded for the live map. Keep an admin refresh (Tavily Extract scrape of Luma + nebius.com/events, dedup by normalized title).

content.name: DevRel team directory
content.notes: Drives /team and the office-hours booking surface (calendly_url gates the 'Book office hours' CTA).

content.name: Fellows roll-call
content.notes: Curated recognition surface; emits noindex,nofollow while curated. Lowest priority; static array is fine to start.

content.name: CMS pages (Page Constructor blocks)
content.notes: Marketing/program copy rendered through Gravity Page Constructor via the [...slug] catch-all. Lets DevRel spin up pages by slug without a deploy.

migration.mechanism: Apply the program schema (directus schema apply schema.yaml + role/permission matrix), then run idempotent ingest scripts per collection.
migration.tooling: docs/content-expansion/state/ingest.mjs — generic Directus ingester (library|projects): live dedup by slug + canonical URL, dry-run by default, --apply to POST. verify.mjs — URL/oEmbed link-check before ingest.
migration.dedup: Normalize URLs before compare; YouTube canonicalizes to yt:<videoId> (avoids collapsing all watch?v= URLs to one key); match by slug + canonical URL.
migration.rollback: Each ingest batch writes a rollback-*.json (delete-by-id) for one-command revert.
migration.verification: Re-confirm live counts from Directus aggregate at migration time (read-replica lag can make limit=-1 under-read vs aggregate count; union live ∪ verified-*.json).

risks.risk: Standing up a parallel Directus-JWT identity could conflict with the existing Nebius SSO at auth.nebius.com.
risks.mitigation: Decide identity source-of-truth before any gated feature (auth-sessions card). Prefer reconciling with auth.nebius.com SSO over a parallel identity. Add CSRF protection on auth POSTs.

risks.risk: Per-user Directus permission scoping done wrong leaks other users' rows.
risks.mitigation: Role-permission matrix with $CURRENT_USER filters; a permission-test gate in CI before portal/admin ship.

risks.risk: Credit claims, event credits, and points grants are privileged writes; the admin approve/reject handlers are no-ops on the reference build.
risks.mitigation: Ship money/points write-flows last on proven rails; pair credit-claims with its admin queue; idempotent, audit-logged approvals.

risks.risk: Builder-submitted library/events/activities entering published collections without review.
risks.mitigation: Submissions enter PENDING/DRAFT; status-filter DRAFT out of public surfaces (esp. the events directory); admin review queues before publish.

risks.risk: DRAFT/PENDING UGC or noindex pages leaking into the sitemap; first-party content invisible to crawlers.
risks.mitigation: Self-enumerating sitemap that excludes hidden pages; keep DRAFT/PENDING out of indexed surfaces; server-rendered HTML for content.

risks.risk: Leaflet map (events + homepage hero) and the R3F membrane touch window and add above-the-fold JS.
risks.mitigation: SSR-safe dynamic imports, non-WebGL fallbacks, Core Web Vitals budget on the hero.

risks.risk: Typesense adds an external dependency to provision and keep indexed.
risks.mitigation: Ship the Directus _icontains fallback first; layer Typesense behind it; document reindex-on-publish.

risks.risk: Feedback overlaps ideas.nebius.com; admin console overlaps Directus Studio.
risks.mitigation: Decide build-vs-reuse per surface; admin console is partly optional vs Studio.
